name: ONE ROOM - Han Salam-eul Wihan Bang
original_name: ONE ROOM - 한 사람을 위한 방
source:
6 People - 1 Room - 1 way to escape.

How would you deal with a situation where you don't know...
where you are and have no clues to find out an escape?
How would you survive?
How far are you willing to stay alive?
And who would you TRUST?
These questions will put you to the test and find out the goal behind this small experiment.

Welcome to One Room - Prisoner's Dilemma.

[from [url=https://zephi.itch.io/one-room-prisoners-dilemma]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
6人 - 1个房间 - 1种逃生方式。

遇到你不知道的情况你会如何处理…
你在哪里却没有找到逃生的线索？
你将如何生存？
你愿意活到什么程度？
你会信任谁？
这些问题将考验你并找出这个小实验背后的目标。

欢迎来到一间房间 - 囚徒困境。

[来自[url=https://zephi.itch.io/one-room-prisoners-dilemma]Itch.io[/url]]
